digest.component_or_area: M2M outbound reconciler — project membership guard and create-path resolution
propositions: Create-path membership test in outbound_differ is case-sensitive but applier guard normalizes to uppercase, causing disagreement when bridge_project case differs from mapping key (e.g. 'b' vs 'B').
Applier guard store-loading wiring through apply() reading seeded projects.json is not exercised end-to-end, only unit-tested at pure-helper level.
run_differs outbound seam does not have a fail-closed test proving malformed projects.json ValueError propagates through load_mapping.
Make create-path membership check case-insensitive and stamp canonical mapping key to align with applier guard normalization.
Add integration test driving apply() with seeded projects.json to exercise real store-loading guard wiring.
Add run_differs-seam test proving malformed projects.json aborts with ValueError (fail-closed).
